status_definitions.READY: Verified by deterministic estate evidence or completed assessment outputs.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Preliminary evidence exists, but gaps or unverified assumptions remain.
status_definitions.GAP: Missing required data, open discovery question, or unmitigated architecture issue.
status_definitions.NOT_ASSESSED: Milestone or inspection has not yet been executed for this engagement.
status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Criteria does not apply to this engagement's scope or technical architecture.

items.title: Server and Application Inventory Ingested
items.description: Comprehensive discovery of servers, applications, and storage volumes loaded into SQL.
items.guidance: Complete estate inventory is required before right-sizing or wave planning can proceed.

items.title: Performance Telemetry Coverage
items.description: At least 30 days of CPU and memory utilization metrics available for right-sizing.
items.guidance: Estates with < 70% monitored servers require conservative sizing and contingency uplift.

items.title: Application Dependency Mapping
items.description: Network traffic flow telemetry and inter-server dependencies identified.
items.guidance: Observed dependency connections define move-groups to eliminate cross-wave latency.

items.title: Business Drivers & Target Region Agreed
items.description: Target Azure primary region and DR paired region approved by stakeholders.
items.guidance: Region selection dictates pricing, service availability, and compliance boundaries.

items.title: Financial Cost Baseline & Proof of Estimate
items.description: Independent monthly Azure run-rate and one-time migration services cost modeled.
items.guidance: All run-rate figures must carry stable calculation appendix formulas and drivers.

items.title: Management Group & Subscription Architecture
items.description: CAF management group hierarchy designed with isolated platform and landing-zone subscriptions.
items.guidance: Follow the Azure Landing Zone conceptual architecture with delegated administration.

items.title: Landing Zone Architecture Checklist Conformance
items.description: Azure Landing Zone design checklist evaluated with documented gap mitigations.
items.guidance: Achieve >= 80% conformance against standard ALZ checklist before wave execution.

items.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Privileged Access
items.description: Least-privilege access model and Entra ID role assignments configured.
items.guidance: No persistent standing admin permissions; enforce PIM on production subscriptions.

items.title: Key Vault & Secrets Management
items.description: Dedicated Azure Key Vault per environment with RBAC and private endpoint controls.
items.guidance: Never store credentials or keys in application code, configuration files, or prompts.

items.title: Hub-Spoke Network Topology & IP Address Plan
items.description: Non-overlapping RFC 1918 CIDR blocks and VNet peering between hub and workload spokes.
items.guidance: Reserve address space for hybrid connectivity gateways, firewalls, and future spokes.

items.title: Hybrid Connectivity & Ingress/Egress Controls
items.description: ExpressRoute or VPN gateway specified with central Azure Firewall or NVA routing.
items.guidance: Validate latency and bandwidth requirements between on-premises and target Azure region.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID Hybrid Identity Integration
items.description: Directory synchronization and authentication posture established for migrated workloads.
items.guidance: Verify domain controller placement and Kerberos/LDAP availability in identity spoke.

items.title: 6R Disposition Assignment & OS Lifecycle Assessment
items.description: Every application assigned Rehost/Replatform/Repurchase/Retire/Retain/Refactor with rationale.
items.guidance: End-of-life operating systems flagged for upgrade, replatform, or Extended Security Updates.

items.title: Database Replatform & Storage Target Architecture
items.description: Database engines mapped to Azure SQL (MI/VM/Hyperscale) or PostgreSQL/MySQL Flexible Server.
items.guidance: Assess RPO, RTO, and transactional volume to select appropriate database replication tier.

items.title: Migration Appliance & Replication Tooling Readiness
items.description: Azure Migrate or Azure Site Recovery tooling validated against source hypervisors.
items.guidance: Test replication appliance communication and network port prerequisites (443, 9443).

items.title: Monitoring, Log Analytics & Alert Routing
items.description: Centralized Log Analytics workspace, diagnostic settings, and metric alerts defined.
items.guidance: Enforce 30-day retention baseline and connect Action Groups for incident response.

items.title: Azure Policy Baseline & Cost Budget Alerts
items.description: Azure Policy initiatives assigned to management groups with 50/80/100% budget alerts.
items.guidance: Enforce allowed regions, required tags, and deny unapproved SKUs or public endpoints.

items.title: Risk-Ordered Wave Plan & Critical Path Schedule
items.description: Wave sequencing with pilot wave first, regulated last, and critical path timeline.
items.guidance: Schedule must bound prep, execution, and soak durations per wave based on throughput.

items.title: Change Advisory Board (CAB) & Cutover Window Schedule
items.description: Agreed maintenance windows and change control approvals for workload cutover.
items.guidance: Document business-approved outage allowances and communication plan.

items.title: Migration Roles Assigned & Resource Loading Modeled
items.description: Functional migration roles mapped via RACI/DACI and month-by-month FTE loading calculated.
items.guidance: Confirm partner and customer staffing capacity matches peak FTE demand.

items.title: Go/No-Go Decision Criteria & Rollback Plan
items.description: Explicit cutover success criteria, validation checklists, and technical rollback triggers.
items.guidance: A migration must never execute without an approved, tested rollback procedure.
